title: How big is a 1 carat Asscher cut?

post.youtube_title: How big is a 1 carat Asscher cut?
post.caption:
A 1 carat Asscher measures about 5.5 by 5.5 millimeters. A 2 carat Asscher covers 42% of the width of a size 6 finger.

Asscher diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/asscher-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts

Estimates for a well-cut stone.
